THE REFORMULATION WORKED AND THE MODEL STILL BARELY MOVES. FAERS seriousness is a RATIO
over a drug's own reports: -0.0999 with report volume, +0.1769 with target count,
against the +0.2898 target count scored on SIDER's effect count in loop 12. R1 and R2 are
the fix landing -- the outcome is no longer a list length.
BUT R3 CLEARS BY +0.0013. fraction of targets essential reaches +0.0839 against a null
95th of 0.0826. That is a pass by the declared gate and it is a hair,
and calling it more than that would be the overstatement this project exists to avoid.
AND R4 SAYS IT DOES NOT TRANSFER. On safety-stopped versus business-stopped trials, every
feature lands BELOW 0.5 and target count itself reaches 0.3124 --
strongly anti-predictive, meaning drugs with FEWER targets are the ones stopped for safety.
Two outcomes from two databases point in opposite directions, on 55 safety-stopped drugs
against 600 business-stopped. The likeliest reason is composition rather than biology:
safety-stopped trials skew oncology, and oncology drugs differ from the rest in target
count, essentiality and everything else. That is a hypothesis this loop did not test,
stated as one.
